gloss: to lock out, to shut out

definitions.gloss: to lock out, to shut out
definitions.explanation: To prevent someone from entering by closing and locking a door. Can refer to accidentally locking oneself out.
To exclude someone from participation, membership, or involvement in something.

examples.japanese: {鍵|かぎ}を{忘|わす}れて{家|いえ}から{閉|し}め{出|だ}されてしまった。
examples.english: I forgot my keys and got locked out of the house.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}を{外|そと}に{閉|し}め{出|だ}さないでください。
examples.english: Please don't lock the cat out.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はグループから{閉|し}め{出|だ}された。
examples.english: He was shut out of the group.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Compound verb: {閉|し}める + {出|だ}す. Pattern: Xを{閉|し}め{出|だ}す (lock X out).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {閉|し}め{出|だ}されている = 'is locked out.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{家|いえ}から{閉|し}め{出|だ}される (get locked out of the house)
・{会議|かいぎ}から{閉|し}め{出|だ}す (shut out from a meeting)
・オートロックで{閉|し}め{出|だ}される (get locked out by the auto-lock)

NOTE: Often used in passive form ({閉|し}め{出|だ}される) when one is the victim of being locked out.
